zero_mechanics.basis: Unchanged pinned pure saved viewer and scalar CSV/JSON comparison; no mechanical imports or callbacks

limitations: Raw archive SHA values directly rechecked; NPZ archive fields not independently decoded in this review. Original pinned viewer executed its canonical descriptor/array-field/fixed-body/per-node holding gates once; this review did not rerun them.
No new mechanical force, tangent, solver, reference, observer or image rendering called. Zero mechanics is static pinned import/provenance evidence, not dynamic hook instrumentation.
Overlap diagnostics do not test mechanism self-overlap or set containment. Unsigned finite tip distance and outward face rays are geometric diagnostics, not pressure or contact certification.
Colored peak meanJ and flattened Hu Frobenius ranges differ from integration-point minima and max absolute Hu components.
Production force, holding opposite, mirror display, half-model signed force and two-sided magnitude remain distinct; no HP, pressure, effective-clamp, convergence or HF5 qualification.
